node.statement: Using (U bold-dot V)^dagger=V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger, insert V^dagger bold-dot(U^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot V)) and then V^dagger bold-dot V=J. The two associator errors are at most 20*epsilon_r and, after left multiplication by V^dagger, 17*epsilon_r respectively (all unitary norms are <=2 and ||U bold-dot V||<5). Therefore ||(U bold-dot V)^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot V)-J||<37*epsilon_r<=40*epsilon_r.
